applicability: Review of a leaf whose enclosure records a delivery: its closeout or its integration reached a completed or checkpointed state, so the delivery's code and memory endpoints are the records the enclosure holds.
conditions: The enclosure records which commit its successful landing produced and which memory content commit its closeout published.
A recorded commit is a full commit id that the repository its record names holds as a commit; only then is its tree derived.
exclusions: The last numbered review record, today's source-line tip, a branch name or a sibling's pair as a delivered endpoint.
The landing record's memory cell standing for the closeout's memory content commit.
A current database or an invented empty memory side replacing an operand the delivery records cannot establish.
statement: A closed leaf's review establishes its delivered sides — the recorded code and memory bases, the commit its successful landing produced and the closeout's memory content commit — from the enclosure's own delivery records, and refuses by name any side it cannot establish as that exact commit and tree; a missing or unestablishable operand is never replaced.
